exercises.title: Be going to — Recupera
exercises.description: Ricostruisci forma e significato di be going to per piani già decisi e previsioni basate su evidenza.
exercises.instructions: Controlla prima il significato, poi scegli am/is/are e usa il verbo base dopo going to.

sections.title: Un piano già deciso o un'evidenza presente
sections.instructions: Non scegliere dalla parola tomorrow: leggi cosa era già deciso o cosa puoi vedere adesso.

questions.title: Be going to: piano deciso o previsione con evidenza
questions.prompt: Prima di esercitarti
questions.learning_objective: Use be going to for prior plans/intentions and evidence-based predictions with correct form.

content.body: Be going to si costruisce con am/is/are + going to + verbo base. È utile per piani già decisi e previsioni sostenute da un'evidenza presente.
content.intro: La domanda utile è: questa intenzione esisteva già prima di parlare, oppure vedo adesso qualcosa che rende il risultato molto probabile?

sections.title: La struttura completa
sections.body: Going to ha bisogno di una forma di be.
sections.pattern: subject + am/is/are + going to + base verb

examples.text: They are going to leave early.

sections.title: Piano o intenzione già decisa
sections.body: Se avevi già deciso il piano prima di parlare, going to è naturale.

examples.text: I've decided to save money. I'm going to cook at home more often.
Sara is going to study design next year.

sections.title: Previsione con evidenza
sections.body: Se la situazione presente ti dà una prova concreta di ciò che sta per succedere, going to è naturale.

examples.text: Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
That glass is falling. It's going to break.

sections.title: Negativa
sections.pattern: subject + am/is/are not + going to + base verb

examples.text: We aren't going to buy it.

sections.title: Domanda
sections.pattern: Am/Is/Are + subject + going to + base verb?

sections.title: Non dimenticare be
sections.body: Going to da solo non basta.

correct.text: She is going to call him.

sections.title: Da ricordare
points: Piano già deciso? → be going to.
Evidenza presente forte? → be going to.
Forma: am/is/are + going to + verbo base.

questions.title: Un piano già deciso
questions.prompt: I've already decided. Next year, ___.
questions.learning_objective: Choose going to for a prior plan.

feedback.explanation: La decisione esiste già: I'm going to study...

questions.title: Costruisci be going to
questions.prompt: Completa la frase.
questions.learning_objective: Build a correct be going to structure.

feedback.explanation: Friends = they → are; dopo going to serve leave.

questions.title: Vedi l'evidenza
questions.prompt: The sky is black and you can hear thunder. What do you say?
questions.learning_objective: Choose going to for an evidence-based prediction.

feedback.explanation: Nuvole scure e tuono sono evidenza presente: It's going to rain.

questions.title: Sistema la negativa
questions.prompt: Correggi: We not going to buy it.
questions.learning_objective: Form a negative going to sentence with be.

accepted_answers: We aren't going to buy it.
We are not going to buy it.

feedback.explanation: La negativa mantiene are: are not / aren't going to buy.

questions.title: Costruisci la domanda
questions.prompt: Metti le parole nell'ordine corretto.
questions.learning_objective: Build a going to question with correct be-subject order.

feedback.explanation: Are + you + going to + apply?

exercises.title: Be going to — Allenati
exercises.description: Pratica piani, intenzioni, evidenza, domande e negative senza rileggere la regola.
exercises.instructions: Decidi prima se il contesto mostra un piano già deciso o un'evidenza presente.

questions.title: Piani per il weekend
questions.prompt: Complete with be going to and the verbs.
questions.learning_objective: Produce going to plans with different subjects.

content.text_template: This weekend, I [[blank_1]] (visit) my grandparents and my parents [[blank_2]] (paint) the kitchen.

feedback.explanation: I → am; parents → are; poi going to + verbo base.

questions.title: Un piano deciso ieri
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural reply.
questions.learning_objective: Use going to naturally for a prior decision.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Have you decided what to do in July?

turns.speaker: Nina
turns.text: Yes. I made the decision yesterday.

options.text: I'm going to work at my uncle's shop.

feedback.explanation: La decisione era già stata presa: I'm going to work...

questions.title: Una previsione visibile
questions.prompt: That child is cycling very fast toward the wall and isn't looking ahead. What do you say?
questions.learning_objective: Use going to for a prediction based on visible evidence.

feedback.explanation: La situazione presente fornisce evidenza concreta: He's going to crash.

questions.title: Due pezzi da sistemare
questions.prompt: Correct: They is going to leaves early.
questions.learning_objective: Correct be agreement and base form after going to.

accepted_answers: They are going to leave early.

feedback.explanation: They → are; dopo going to → leave.

questions.title: Chiedi del piano
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a natural going to question.

feedback.explanation: What + are + you + going to + study?

questions.title: Traduci l'intenzione
questions.prompt: Quest'anno risparmierò di più: ho già fatto un piano.
questions.instructions: Translate using be going to for the plan.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a going to plan from an explicit prior-decision context.

accepted_answers: I'm going to save more money this year; I've already made a plan.
I am going to save more money this year; I have already made a plan.

feedback.explanation: Il piano è già deciso: I'm going to save...

questions.title: Quali forme sono complete?
questions.prompt: Select all grammatically correct sentences.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one answer.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise correct going to forms across subjects and polarity.

options.text: She's going to apply for the course.
We aren't going to stay long.

feedback.explanation: Serve be + going to + verbo base.

questions.title: Evidenza e forma
questions.prompt: Complete the prediction.
questions.learning_objective: Combine evidence-based prediction meaning with correct going to form.

content.text_template: Look at that shelf! It [[blank_1]] going to [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: L'evidenza è presente; forma: is going to fall.

exercises.title: Be going to — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Applica be going to in formati tipici di una verifica scolastica.
exercises.instructions: Completa tutto prima di vedere il feedback.

sections.title: Verifica scolastica
sections.instructions: Controlla uso, be e verbo base.

questions.title: Complete the sentences
questions.prompt: Use the correct form of be going to and the verb in brackets.
questions.learning_objective: Produce going to forms with mixed subjects and polarity.

content.text_template: 1. I [[blank_1]] (study) tonight. 2. They [[blank_2]] (not/buy) the car. 3. Sara [[blank_3]] (visit) her aunt.

feedback.explanation: Controlla am/is/are + going to + base verb.

questions.title: Correct the mistake
questions.prompt: Correct: He going to take the train.
questions.learning_objective: Restore the missing be auxiliary in a going to sentence.

accepted_answers: He is going to take the train.
He's going to take the train.

feedback.explanation: He richiede is: He is going to take...

questions.title: Make a question
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a going to wh-question in school format.

feedback.explanation: Where + are + they + going to + stay?

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: Abbiamo deciso: non compreremo una macchina nuova quest'anno.
questions.learning_objective: Translate a prior negative plan using going to.

accepted_answers: We've decided: we aren't going to buy a new car this year.
We have decided: we are not going to buy a new car this year.
We aren't going to buy a new car this year; we've decided.

feedback.explanation: Decisione già presa: aren't going to buy.

questions.title: Choose the best sentence
questions.prompt: You see a glass at the edge of a table and it is moving. What do you say?
questions.learning_objective: Recognise an evidence-based prediction with going to.

feedback.explanation: L'evidenza presente rende naturale going to.

questions.title: Complete the exchange
questions.prompt: Choose the correct forms.
questions.learning_objective: Coordinate going to question and answer structures.

content.text_template: A: [[blank_1]] Luca going to apply? B: Yes, he [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: Is Luca going to...? Yes, he is.

exercises.title: Be going to — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma su piani, evidenza, struttura, domande e negative con be going to.
exercises.instructions: Completa senza aiuti. Il feedback arriva alla fine.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Leggi il contesto e poi costruisci la forma completa.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: I made the decision last week. Next month, ___.
questions.learning_objective: Choose going to for a prior decision.

options.text: I'm going to start a new course.
I going to start a new course.
I'm going to starts a new course.

feedback.explanation: La decisione è precedente al momento di parlare: going to.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.prompt: Complete the plans.
questions.learning_objective: Produce going to forms with correct be agreement.

content.text_template: I [[blank_1]] (study) tonight and my friends [[blank_2]] (meet) us later.

feedback.explanation: I → am; friends → are; going to + verbo base.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.prompt: Correct: My sister are going to study medicine.
questions.learning_objective: Correct be agreement in going to.

accepted_answers: My sister is going to study medicine.
My sister's going to study medicine.

feedback.explanation: My sister = she → is going to study.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a going to information question independently.

feedback.explanation: When + are + you + going to + leave?

questions.title: Item 5
questions.prompt: Non compreremo quei biglietti: abbiamo già cambiato piano.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a negative going to plan from Italian.

accepted_answers: We aren't going to buy those tickets; we've already changed our plan.
We are not going to buy those tickets; we have already changed our plan.

feedback.explanation: Piano già modificato: aren't going to buy.

questions.title: Item 6
questions.prompt: Select all grammatically correct sentences.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one answer.
questions.learning_objective: Discriminate correct going to structures across subjects and polarity.

options.text: They're going to leave after lunch.

feedback.explanation: Struttura completa: be + going to + verbo base.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.prompt: You see a runner holding his ankle and unable to continue. What prediction is best supported by the situation?
questions.learning_objective: Select going to for a prediction based on present evidence.

feedback.explanation: L'evidenza presente sostiene direttamente la previsione.

questions.title: Item 8
questions.prompt: Complete the question and answer.
questions.learning_objective: Coordinate going to question and short answer structures.

content.text_template: A: [[blank_1]] they going to move house? B: No, they [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: Are they going to...? No, they aren't.

questions.title: Item 9
questions.prompt: Correct: Are you going to studying tonight?
questions.learning_objective: Correct the main verb after going to in a question.

accepted_answers: Are you going to study tonight?

feedback.explanation: Dopo going to serve il verbo base: study.

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural reply.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise going to in a prior-plan dialogue.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Have you decided what course to take?

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Yes, I chose it with my parents last weekend.

feedback.explanation: La decisione era già stata presa: I'm going to study...

questions.title: Item 11
questions.prompt: Guarda quelle nuvole: sta per piovere. Noi non usciremo; abbiamo già deciso di restare a casa.
questions.instructions: Translate using be going to for both ideas.
questions.learning_objective: Produce both evidence prediction and prior-plan meanings with correct going to forms.

accepted_answers: Look at those clouds: it's going to rain. We aren't going to go out; we've already decided to stay at home.
Look at those clouds: it is going to rain. We are not going to go out; we have already decided to stay at home.

feedback.explanation: Prima evidenza presente; poi piano già deciso. Entrambi usano be going to con forma completa.
